decision_chain: §5 qc_flags -> §6 preprocess_for_view (full range) -> §7 pick_peaks -> §8 band_evidence with acquisition range rounded to 0.1 cm-1 -> §15 tier (k1, k2, _verdict) -> §16 floor (fluorescence corr read from the qc string). Must reproduce all 47 field reference rows before any corpus spectrum is decided.

diagnostic_wavenumber_offset.report: median, IQR and fraction with |offset| > MATCH_TOL, per library and class
diagnostic_wavenumber_offset.use: descriptive only; never used to correct an axis or change a decision
diagnostic_wavenumber_offset.what: for each in-scope spectrum and each key band of its TRUE class, the nearest detected peak within +/-15 cm-1; offset = measured - library

groups: SLoPP and SLoPP-E reported separately, never pooled

metrics.primary_label_set: emitted labels (confident + tentative that pass the floor), as used for the field reference
metrics.related: excluded from numerator and denominator of the primary metrics; a strict PPV counting related emissions as wrong is reported alongside

not_done: stream 2 (SLoPP correlation) and support levels are not computed on the corpus (circular)
no parameter of the rule is tuned on the corpus

outcomes.in: correct (emitted == truth) / wrong (other class emitted) / inconclusive (withheld)
outcomes.related: related (emitted in related_classes) / wrong / inconclusive; counts only
outcomes.structurally_undecidable: truth class with < 2 key bands (acrylonitrile_copolymer, natural_isoprene): reported apart, withheld is the only correct outcome

primary_analysis.axis: corpus resampled to the field spacing 3.104 cm-1 (resample_uniform)
primary_analysis.reason: the point-based parameters of §6 and §7 (despike 5, SG 9, ALS lambda, peak distance 3, noise from point differences) were set on spectra at this spacing

purpose: Class-level performance of the frozen band rule on spectra of depositor-labelled identity (SLoPP, SLoPP-E). The rule is not changed for this analysis.

sensitivity_analyses.change: no resampling; corpus at its own spacing
sensitivity_analyses.name: as_distributed

sensitivity_analyses.change: primary, restricted to laser_nm within 532 +/- 5 nm
sensitivity_analyses.name: excitation_532

truth_table.rule: in / related / out as stated in §17-0a
